title: Destination choice after banish does not offer 'any battlefield' and wrongly offers Base
expected: Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/thrill-of-the-hunt.ts:24-27) emits play with `toLocation: { battlefield: "any" }`, but the engine never inspects that shape (no `battlefield === "any"` handling anywhere in riftbound-engine/src). In abilities/effects/play.ts:207 any non-"base" toLocation collapses to `dest = "choose"`, queuing a generic `{to:"choose", type:"move"}` chain item. That resolves in abilities/effects/move.ts:564-582, where for a card entering play from off-board (banishment) `enteringPlay` is true and options = ["base", ...battlefields filtered to bf.controller === ctx.playerId]. So Base is always offered and uncontrolled/empty battlefields are dropped — exactly the observed ["base"] / ["base","battlefield-...bf2"]. Rule 355.2.b says an effect can make otherwise-invalid locations valid; the card's "any battlefield" override is not implemented.
observed: choose-destination pendingChoice options were ["base"] only when no friendly units were at either battlefield (unit was forced back to base); in a second test with a friendly unit at bf2 the options were ["base","battlefield-player-2-bf-ogn-277-298"] — the empty battlefield was never offered and Base was always offered. Engine appears to apply normal play-location legality instead of the card's 'any battlefield' override.
